g.text: Across seven cohorts, IQ was 6.7 points lower at a blood lead of 30 than at 2.4 micrograms per decilitre.

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: More than half of that gap, 3.8 points, came between 2.4 and 10.
